title: Evening Ottawa ByWard Market Food Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover the vibrant ByWard Market District on a guided food tour that showcases Ottawa's culinary delights. This walking tour invites you to savor three savory dishes and a sweet treat from local favorites while learning about the neighborhood's rich history from an experienced guide. Each stop is thoughtfully selected to provide an authentic taste of the area, with an option to enjoy a beer or wine at one location. Perfect for food lovers and cultural enthusiasts, this tour captures the essence of one of Canada’s most beloved markets.

- Guided walking tour through Ottawa's historic ByWard Market
- Sample 3 savory dishes and 1 sweet treat from local vendors
- Enjoy a beer or wine at one of the food stops (non-alcoholic option available)
- Experience the rich history and culture of the ByWard Market with an expert guide
